title: IBM i 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information from the…
description: IBM i versions 7.6, 7.5, 7.4, and 7.3 contain a vulnerability in the Host-Based Printer Subsystem that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information. This occurs due to the absence of an authorization check, enabling unauthorized printing of files. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.8.
